events.body:
## Context

`public/index.html` has infinite pulse animations, an animated SVG map, tiles re-animated every 400 ms and `document.title` rewritten every second, with no `prefers-reduced-motion` handling. Tiles look clickable (`cursor: pointer`) but aren't.

## What to do

1. Add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` and skip the tile interval when it matches.
2. Show the timestamp in a visible element instead of `document.title`.
3. Remove `cursor: pointer` from tiles.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Nothing animates with reduced motion emulated
- [ ] Title is static
- [ ] Tiles don't look clickable

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-dash/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```
